jobs.description:
Job Description

This position has been deemed critical by the Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability Dean’s Office and is exempt from the hiring pause.

This position is based on Stanford’s main campus with consideration given to the option for a hybrid work schedule (partially onsite 3 or more days a week), subject to operational need.

Interested candidates must include a resume and cover letter to be considered for this position.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa.

About Us

The Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability strives to create a future when humans and nature thrive in concert and in perpetuity. The school is made up of a three-part structure to drive global impact: Our academic departments and programs educate students and create new knowledge across areas of research that are crucial for advancing the long-term prosperity of the planet and people; Institutes bridge scholarship at Stanford and beyond, bringing multiple viewpoints to bear on urgent challenges; The Sustainability Accelerator drives new policy and technology solutions through a worldwide network of partners who work with our teams to develop solutions at a global scale. The school is dedicated to creating and supporting a community with the richness of experience and background needed to create solutions that benefit all people, particularly those most affected by environmental damage and climate change.

For more information on the school, click here .

The SDSS Sustainability Accelerator (the Sustainability Accelerator) serves as a launchpad for sustainability solutions, turning innovative ideas into transformative and scalable technologies and policies that will substantially improve the quality of human life and our planet. The Sustainability Accelerator is rooted in the Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability and works across the University and with external partners to drive solutions from the lab into the world.

The Accelerator is seeking a full-time Administrative Associate to join our operations team and provide administrative and programmatic support across our growing portfolio of sustainability initiatives. This position will serve as the primary administrative contact for four portfolios of faculty research projects (“Flagships”) managed by the Accelerator, supporting their day-to-day coordination and helping connect faculty, research teams, and Accelerator staff with the administrative resources they need. We are looking for a highly organized, collaborative, and service-oriented professional who brings strong communication skills, careful attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities. The ideal candidate will be comfortable supporting meetings and events, coordinating schedules and logistics, maintaining information and administrative systems, and assisting with a range of operational needs in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Managing complex calendars with limited consultation; resolve scheduling conflicts; negotiating and managing the needs of individuals or groups requesting time with the Accelerator members and faculty researchers
Creating and managing scheduling polls.
Managing complicated business travel in compliance with unit, university and sponsor policies. Processing associated travel reimbursements.
Organizing electronic files and documents in Google drive and other similar systems for efficient access.
Serving as the primary administrative support contact for four portfolios of faculty research projects at the Accelerator.
Overseeing and/or performing duties associated with scheduling, organizing, and operating complex conferences, seminars, and events, including arranging with vendors for services, overseeing the production and distribution of materials, administering logistics, and managing event within budget.
Composing and drafting documents and correspondence for presentations, course handouts, grants, conferences, seminars, and reports; perform substantial editing and fact checking. Creating, maintaining, modifying, and/or ensuring accuracy of content in various unit documents, displays, reports, brochures, social media, and/or websites.
Creating complex reports and spreadsheets which may utilize specialized software and systems.
Overseeing and/or processing a variety of complex financial transactions; produce, monitor, and reconcile budget statements; research, identify, and resolve discrepancies. May assist with capital or special equipment requests and/or vendor selection.

The expected pay range for this position is $40.10 to $47.04 per hour.

jobs.description:
This is a hybrid/ Onsite position.

For nearly 40 years, Naughty Dog has been crafting best-selling, critically acclaimed games that constantly push the boundaries of narrative, gameplay, and technology. Naughty Dog recently released The Last of Us Part II Remastered as well as a current generation remake of The Last of Us Part I for the PS5. We're also proud to say that The Last of Us Parts I and II are now available for the first time on PC. Currently, we’re busy at the kennel working on Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, and we’d love to find talented individuals to join us.

Naughty Dog games have long been lauded for their evocative, character-driven stories and attention to detail. We are committed to innovation within our games and as such have curated some of the top creative and technically innovative minds in the industry. We welcome diverse candidates and believe that a broad range of cultural and life experiences contribute to the overall well-being and success of the studio and the titles we craft together.

Naughty Dog is looking for a Research Data Analyst to join our User Research team and help us better understand how players engage with our games. In this role, you’ll work closely with Sony Game Analytics and development teams to turn player data into insight that can directly support creative and production decisions.

This position is ideal for someone who is curious, analytical, and deeply interested in how player behavior connects to game systems and design intent. Beyond working with technical tools and valuable reports, you’ll be expected to identify meaningful trends, surfacing potential issues, to help teams understand the “why” behind player patterns. A strong candidate will be comfortable working across disciplines and excited to contribute to our games.

What You Will Do

Analyze gameplay telemetry, player feedback, and research findings to identify trends, friction points, and opportunities across systems and features.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and recommendations that inform design, prioritization, and development strategy.
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools to communicate key metrics and progress over time with tools like Tableau and Omni.
Partner with Sony Game Analytics, Gameplay, Engineering, and Design to support telemetry design, event tracking, and data quality.
Collaborate with User Research to connect quantitative analysis with qualitative findings from studies and playtests.
Participate in research efforts to better understand player behavior firsthand and identify new measurement opportunities.

What Skills You Will Use

3–5 years of experience in data analysis, analytics, UX research support, or a related field.
Experience working with telemetry data and game analytics workflows.
Strong analytical and statistical skills, including experience with SQL, Python, R, MongoDB, or similar tools.
Experience with analytics platforms such as Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms
A deep curiosity about player psychology, motivation, and behavior.
High attention to detail, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
Ability to effectively present information to top management and key stakeholders
A collaborative mindset and adaptability to the ever changing needs of video game production.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Psychology, Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, or a related quantitative or research focused field.
Familiarity with narrative, single player game research and player experience evaluation.
Solid understanding of probability, statistics, and applied mathematical reasoning.
Ability to interpret technical and research materials and communicate findings clearly in reports and presentations.
Possesses a high degree of technical curiosity, regularly exploring how tools work under the hood.
Prior experience with AAA console or PC game development.

Partner with engineering, customer service, and network teams to resolve complex issues, and provide regular updates to the technical support team and management on field operations

jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Utility Field Technician – Power Pole Data Collection

Location
:
Pikeville, KY

Primary Field Area
:
Pikeville and communities throughout eastern Kentucky.

About This Opportunity

Sigma Technologies is seeking a Utility Field Technician to collect information and document overhead power-distribution infrastructure throughout eastern Kentucky.

This is a field-based opportunity for someone who enjoys working outdoors, staying active, traveling throughout the region, and managing their work independently. Previous utility or field data-collection experience is preferred, but not required.

What To Know Before Applying

Field assignments involve year-round outdoor work in heat, cold, rain, humidity, and direct sunlight.
The work requires driving throughout eastern Kentucky and walking over mountainous, steep, uneven, muddy, wooded, or otherwise difficult terrain.
A reliable personal vehicle is required, and mileage reimbursement is provided at the company-designated rate. Due to local terrain and road conditions, a reliable four-wheel-drive or all-wheel-drive vehicle is strongly preferred.
Assignments may require driving an hour, or more, one way and staying overnight Monday through Thursday when necessary.
New hires must attend an initial two-week, in-person, paid orientation and training program at our headquarters in Perrysburg, Ohio.

What You Can Expect To Do

Conduct field surveys of overhead power-distribution facilities.
Locate, inspect, photograph, measure, and document utility poles, power lines, transformers, attachments, and related infrastructure.
Record pole conditions, equipment information, attachment details, clearances, and surrounding field conditions.
Use maps, mobile devices, GIS-based applications, and electronic data-collection tools to locate facilities and document information.
Upload accurate photographs, measurements, field notes, and other required project information.
Plan daily routes and manage assigned work efficiently throughout the designated field area.
Communicate with project management, engineering, and design teams regarding field conditions, access concerns, or missing information.
Follow all company, customer, traffic, and field-safety requirements.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

High school diploma or equivalent required.
Previous experience in utilities, power distribution, telecommunications, construction, surveying, inspection, GIS, or field data collection is preferred but not required.
Ability to work independently, manage daily assignments, and remain productive with limited direct supervision.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately document field conditions.
Comfort using mobile devices, email, maps, electronic forms, and data-collection applications.
Ability to read maps, follow assigned routes, and navigate rural or unfamiliar locations.
Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills.
Reliable personal transportation, a valid driver’s license, and automobile insurance meeting Sigma’s minimum requirements.
Ability to successfully complete required background, drug, and driving-record checks.
Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Physical Requirements

Ability to drive and sit in a vehicle for extended periods while traveling between field locations.
Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, potentially five miles or more in a workday.
Ability to navigate steep, uneven, rocky, muddy, wooded, or otherwise difficult terrain on foot.
Ability to lift, carry, and balance equipment or other objects weighing up to approximately 40 pounds.
Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, climb, reach, and maintain balance while collecting field information.
Ability to work safely near roadways, moving vehicles, utility infrastructure, vegetation, and other field hazards.
Ability to visually locate, inspect, photograph, and measure objects at varying distances.

What We Offer

We want our Associates to stay healthy, happy, and secure. Sigma offers a positive work environment with supportive coworkers, managers, and leaders, along with:

Competitive compensation.
Medical, dental, and vision plans with up to 80% of the premium sponsored by Sigma.
401(k) plan with company matching contributions of up to 5% of salary.
Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time.
Education and professional licensing assistance programs.
Mileage reimbursement for the required use of a personal vehicle in accordance with company policy.

About Sigma Technologies

Sigma Technologies is a growing engineering and design firm supporting the power and telecommunications industries. For more than 25 years, our work has helped strengthen infrastructure and positively impact communities across the country.

Our core values—Safety, Honesty, Truth, and Decency—guide our work and shape our culture. We are TeamSigma™.

Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

Job Description

Position Summary:

The Field Technician assists with routine and non-routine sampling, monitoring, and data

collection activities in support of environmental monitoring programs and client service

requests.

Field Technician responsibilities include, but are not limited, to the following:

Collects, documents, packages, and ships samples in accordance with appropriate project

specific sampling and analysis protocols.

Perform sampling of hazardous and non-hazardous environmental samples.
Assists with routine sample preparation and/or analyses, generally on site, in support of

mobile laboratory operations or screening surveys

Completes documents and is responsible for quality control of all assignments
Plan and complete daily assigned route in accordance with priorities. Notify supervisor of any

changes to plan.

Prepare and deliver sample containers/materials to various clients in support of their account.
Regularly transport, set up, utilize, troubleshoot and break down sample collection/monitoring

equipment in support of assigned projects/customer accounts.

Communicate directly with customers providing clear and accurate information concerning

their sample collection timeline and access requirements.

Communicate with supervisor and main laboratory, routinely sending timeline and

sample/project updates throughout assigned daily route.

Perform miscellaneous on-site testing when required, record all data, and complete/submit all

required sample documents.

Transport samples from the field back to the laboratory, maintaining accurate sample custody

documentation, occasionally link up with other technicians mid-route to facilitate sample transport and supply exchanges.

Drive safely and observe all traffic laws. Maintain assigned vehicle according to company expectations for cleanliness and maintenance.
Observe all OSHA safety requirements while adhering to the company health and safety policies; do not enter any confined space(s) without direct approval from upper management.
Fill out and maintain documentation/records related to field sampling activity. Document all data as required by the method performed and maintain logbook records in a complete and ethical manner
Trouble-shooting and resolution of field equipment.
Perform preventative maintenance checks on all applicable instrumentation.
Work assigned shift/hours in support of business needs maintaining flexibility to work overtime, weekends and/or holidays when requested.
Follows and enforces company health and safety policies
Must be able to follow technical instructions and guidance.
Perform other duties as required or assigned.

Role is Monday - Friday, 7am -3:30pm, with additional hours as needed.

Qualifications

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent
Must have a valid driver's license and possess a clean driving record.
Ability to operate a motor vehicle
Must be able to navigate using vehicle GPS, road maps, and written directions.
Must be able to lift up to 25lbs consistently, and up to 50 lbs occasionally.
Professional working proficiency in English is a requirement, including the ability to read, write
and speak in English.
Must be authorized to work in the United States without restriction or sponsorship

The Ideal Candidate Would Possess

2+ years of environmental field testing experience, ideally drinking water and wastewatersampling

Additional Information

As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options.

The benefits package offered will vary based on the employee’s full-time or part-time regular status.

We support your development!
Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity!
Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us!
At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and Eurofins Scientific agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Problem resolution

Staff oversight and supervision
Staff scheduling

Collaborate with Community Case Managers, respite referral agencies, and community mental health providers to address barriers to program participation.
Manage referrals, intake processes, and attendance tracking for GUIDE/Respite Program participants.

Ensure staff and aides carry out assigned responsibilities effectively and in a timely manner.

Monitor completion of daily documentation related to staff duties and client services.

Demonstrate leadership by evaluating workloads and motivating staff to perform efficiently and effectively.

Collaborate with Transportation staff to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable transportation services for clients.
Review transportation schedules to optimize pick-up and arrival times.
Ensure staff assignments are developed and reviewed regularly.

Report any gaps in program delivery to the Clinical Supervisor and Administrative Manager.

Schedule care planning meetings in a timely manner and prepare comprehensive meeting summaries.
Distribute care plan summaries to Community Case Managers and healthcare providers, as appropriate.
